messages:
Alex CS: heads-up — Acme reported a regression right after today's rollout. their ingest pipeline started failing JSON schema validation. they say top-level `order.items` is now a string instead of an object/array.

Maya Eng: ugh. do we have a request id or example? can you paste a sample response and the model+variant they hit?

Alex CS: sample request id: r-9f3b2c1e. customer payload + returned body (shortened):
```
request: {
  \"input\": \"summarize order #1234\"
}
response (before): {
  \"order\": { \"id\": 1234, \"items\": [{ \"sku\": \"A1\", \"qty\": 2 }] }
}
response (now): {
  \"order\": { \"id\": 1234, \"items\": \"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"A1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":2}]\" }
}
```

Devon ML: thanks. which model/route? did Acme pin a version?

Alex CS: they call the hosted endpoint: `redwood.completions.create` with model `rw-infer-empirical-v3` (no pin). rolled to 10% canary ~ 22:04 UTC.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: model deployment `rw-infer-empirical-v3` promoted to canary on prod-us-east at 2026-03-15T22:04:17Z by ci/cd.

Maya Eng: can someone repro locally with that model? if it's a generation change, might be prompt shaping or formatting heuristics changed in the new release.

Devon ML: on it — running a few seeds. quick hypothesis: encoder/decoding change that now wraps JSON-like text in quotes when it thinks the field is a \"single token\" or when the output formatter enforces text fence. also possible we tightened schema-linting that coerces non-JSON trees into strings.

Alex CS: customer impact: their downstream parser fails, order ingest stops. severity: P1 for them. they already opened a support ticket and want rollback if this is the canary.

Carla Prod: flagging rollback. @sre-oncall can you evaluate risk vs impact? we should also prepare a hotfix if rollback not possible.

sre-oncall: looking. current canary at 10% traffic; we can pause traffic routing for rw-infer-empirical-v3 now. initiating pause and notifying autoscaler.

Maya Eng: pls attach the exact raw model output for r-9f3b2c1e and the API wrapper logs (content-type, response headers). need to know whether wrapper added quotes or model returned them.

Alex CS: pasted raw model output to ticket thread (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SUP-4123) and added customer repro steps. snippet below (raw):
```
{\"order\":{\"id\":1234,\"items\":\"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"A1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":2}]\"}}
```

Devon ML: confirmed raw model output includes the quoted array. that suggests model output changed, not wrapper. reproducing locally with the same prompt yields same quoted behavior under the new weights. older checkpoint returns proper array.

Maya Eng: excellent signal. probable regression introduced by postprocessing or a prompt-template tweak in the production prompts. check prompt templates change log between commits.

Devon ML: found the PR: `standardize-json-fencing` — it added a heuristic that wraps detected JSON fields with quotes when not strictly validated. author: @karen-ml. rolling back that heuristic on a branch now and testing.

Carla Prod: ETA for rollback or patch? customer is threatening to pause integration if not fixed by EOD.

Devon ML: if we revert the heuristic and redeploy canary, we can validate in ~60-90m. if SRE can re-point canary to previous model immediately, we can restore behavior faster.

sre-oncall: we paused canary traffic; routing reverted to stable model. monitoring for errors spike. please confirm with customer and ask them to validate.

Alex CS: pinged Acme support contact. awaiting confirmation. they said they see immediate improvement after pause. will close loop when they confirm full ingest success. :relieved:

Maya Eng: follow-up actions: (1) create regression test using Acme's schema and sample prompts, (2) add an automated smoke check for fields that look like JSON arrays/objects to assert no accidental quoting, (3) add canary guardrail to flag structured-output drift.

Devon ML: noted. I'll open PR to revert heuristic + add unit test and add a model-output-e2e test using their prompt set.

Alex CS: thanks team. logging ticket SUP-4123 as P1. will update ACME and paste their final confirmation here.

Carla Prod: good work — keep thread updated.

Alex CS: acme confirmed full ingest passes now. closing for now, will reopen if they see recurring drift. :white_check_mark:
